import numpy as np, collections
for n in (1,2,3):
    g=np.array(G[f'Demo pair {n} input']); o=np.array(G[f'Demo pair {n} output'])
    rows=[i for i in range(g.shape[0]) if any(x==5 for x in g[i])]
    cols=[j for j in range(g.shape[1]) if any(g[i][j]==5 for i in range(g.shape[0]))]
    r0,r1,c0,c1=min(rows),max(rows),min(cols),max(cols); H,W=r1-r0+1,c1-c0+1
    mid_r,mid_c=(H-1)//2,(W-1)//2
    # center cell(s)
    print('pair',n,'frame',(r0,c0,H,W))
    for i in range(H):
        for j in range(W):

def f(inp):
    g=np.array(inp); out=g.copy()
    ys=[i for i in range(g.shape[0]) if any(x==5 for x in g[i])]

    col_seq=[5,2,5,0]
    k=1
    while True:
        s=L-2*k
        if s<1: break

        for i in range(top,bot+1): out[i][right]=col_seq[k%4]
        k+=1

import numpy as np, collections
def cc(n):
    g=np.array(G[f'Demo pair {n} input']); o=np.array(G[f'Demo pair {n} output'])
    oh,ow=g.shape
    # find frame bounds (rows/cols containing 5)
    rows=[r for r in range(oh) if 5 in g[r]]
    cols=[c for c in range(ow) if 5 in g[:,c]]
    r0,r1,c0,c1=min(rows),max(rows),min(cols),max(cols)
    mr,mc=(r0+r1)/2,(c0+c1)/2
    m=collections.defaultdict(set)
    for i in range(r0,r1+1):
        for j in range(c0,c1+1):
            d=max(abs(i-mr),abs(j-mc))
            m[d].add(int(o[i][j]))
    return dict(sorted(m.items()))
print(cc(1),cc(2),cc(3))

import numpy as np, collections
# Build exact mapping: for each interior cell (not frame), features -> color
def analyze(n):
    g=np.array(G[f'Demo pair {n} input']); o=np.array(G[f'Demo pair {n} output'])
    oh,ow=g.shape
    rows=[r for r in range(oh) if 5 in g[r]]
    cols=[c for c in range(ow) if 5 in g[:,c]]
    r0,r1,c0,c1=min(rows),max(rows),min(cols),max(cols)
    feats=[]
    for i in range(r0+1,r1):
        for j in range(c0+1,c1):
            dv=i-(r0+ (0 if i<r1 else r1)) if False else None
            # distances to the four frame segments
            dtop=r0-i; dbot=r1-i; dleft=c0-j; dright=c1-j
            m=min(dtop,dbot,dleft,dright)
            nv=min(dbot,dtop)-0  # vertical band index
            feats.append((m,(dtop-dbot)%2,(dleft-dright)%2,int(o[i][j])))
    return sorted(set(feats))
for n in (1,2,3): print('pair',n,analyze(n))

import numpy as np, collections
for n in (1,2,3):
    gi=np.array(G[f'Demo pair {n} input']); go=np.array(G[f'Demo pair {n} output'])
    changed=[(i,j,int(gi[i][j]),int(go[i][j])) for i in range(gi.shape[0]) for j in range(gi.shape[1]) if gi[i][j]!=go[i][j]]
    rows=[r for r in range(gi.shape[0]) if 5 in gi[r]]; cols=[c for c in range(gi.shape[1]) if 5 in gi[:,c]]
    r0,r1,c0,c1=min(rows),max(rows),min(cols),max(cols)
    print('pair',n,'changed:',sorted(set((a,b) for _,_,a,b in changed)))
    cnt=collections.Counter()
    for i,j,a,b in changed:
        k=max(i-r0, r1-i, j-c0, c1-j)
        cnt[(k,a,b)]+=1
    for kk in sorted(cnt): print('  layer',kk[: ],'col->new:',cnt[kk])
